name: Adology
description:
Stop screenshotting competitor ads into a deck nobody reads. Adology turns competitor advertising into structured answers you can act on.

Ask about any brand's ad strategy and get intelligence back: which hooks they run, how their creative is built, what formats and CTAs convert, and how spend shifts over time.

Built for agencies and brand marketers, the Adology connector lets you:

Analyze competitor creative across Meta, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Reddit, and LinkedIn
Decode the elements driving performance: hooks, formats, messaging, and offers
Track brands, competitors, and influencers in reusable Knowledge Sets
Benchmark share of voice and creative trends across a full category
Surface AI and search visibility for any brand

Instead of guessing, you get sourced competitive intelligence in the same conversation where you plan campaigns, briefs, and content.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Adology to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Adology to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.adologyai.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Adology MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adology lists 43 MCP tools, including aggregate, analyze, author_portfolio_context, check_pull, confirm_pull, create_portfolio, create_project, delete_project, fetch_comments, fetch_reviews, get_account_summary, and get_ad_detail.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Adology?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Adology in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Adology requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Adology is developed by Adology. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
